description: Creates a part or an assembly from the user's default template for it (or a named template) and makes it the active document. With path, saves it there at once. The document is the agent's own, so document.close may close it.

type.description: What to create: part or assembly (drawings come in a later release). Default part.

template.description: Full path of a template: .PRTDOT for a part, .ASMDOT for an assembly; the user's default template for the type when absent.

path.description: Full path of a file that does not exist yet, in an existing folder, with the type's extension (.SLDPRT, .SLDASM): the new document is saved there at once.
